messages:
Jamie: Heads up — saw a set of tenants where the invoice preview totals jump after recent route attribute enrichment. Final invoice lines are stable. Likely grouping key drift.

Keisha: I traced it. route-enricher added `routing_variant` and some downstream preview consumers are grouping by the full envelope instead of canonical route. Billing finalizer strips `routing_variant`.

Arman: Sample sanitized event: {tenant: T-303, route: 'embed-us', routing_variant: 'v2', tokens: 520}. Preview aggregator created a separate bucket for v2.

Priya: So preview vs billing disagree because preview didn't normalize. We need a short-term safety net: show "estimated" and callout in console for affected tenants + immediate normalization in preview path.

Jamie: Ops, can we patch preview-ingest to run route-normalize as a last-mile transform? Minimal change: drop unknown ephemeral attrs from grouping key.

OpsBot: K8s job request created to deploy preview-normalizer v2.0 to us-west canary. ETA 20m.

Keisha: Longer-term: make attribution key explicit in the metering API (callers set x-metering-key or we compute canonical_route) so adding enrichers can't silently change billing. Need API contract update + migration plan.

Arman: Agree. I'll open RFC for metering-key header and a compatibility shim: if missing, compute canonical_route from (route, routing_variant) using mapping table; if present, respect it.

BillingBot: Recommend adding alert rule: preview_delta_pct > 4% for tenants with monthly > $300 triggers page to billing/engops. Also emit audit events when enrichment fields roll out.

Priya: Backfill idea: replay 48h of preview envelopes through the normalizer and diff against current preview. Dry-run first and surface top N tenant deltas. Estimate?

Arman: Rough: 48h per region ~2.5 CPU-hours, ~900GB IO, parallelizable across 12 shards -> ~40m. Dry-run to compute deltas should be cheaper. I'll add job spec to the RFC.

Keisha: QA: add integration test injecting random enrichment attrs and assert preview aggregator normalizes. Also add unit test covering attribute-drop policy.

Jamie: Console UX: show timeline annotation where normalization was flipped, and an explanation tooltip linking to changelog + support template. Priya, can you draft the banner?

Priya: Drafting now. Also suggest we hide preview invoices for tenants with delta > 10% until backfill completes.

BillingBot: +1 on hide-if-large-delta. Prevents CS churn.

OpsBot: Canary deploy started. Will report health and index of normalized events once done.

Arman: I'll start the metering-key RFC and include migration steps (feature-flag, shim, backfill plan).

Jamie: Great. Action items: Arman RFC+job spec, Ops roll preview-normalizer canary, Keisha add mapping table and tests, Priya draft console banner + hide rule, BillingBot update alerts. Follow up in 1h or on PAGE if anything breaks.

QA Bot: Added preview-normalizer cases to pre-merge CI.
